name: Applied Thermodynamics: Cycles, Mixtures & Combustion
summary: Applying thermodynamics to power and refrigeration cycles, gas mixtures, psychrometrics, combustion and chemical equilibrium.

topics.name: Gas power cycles: Otto, Diesel, dual, Stirling and Ericsson
Brayton cycle with regeneration, intercooling and reheat; jet-propulsion cycle overview
Vapour power cycles: Rankine with superheat, reheat and regeneration
Refrigeration and heat pump cycles: vapour-compression, absorption and gas refrigeration
Non-reacting gas mixtures (Dalton and Amagat models)
Psychrometrics: humidity, dew point and the psychrometric chart
Air-conditioning processes: heating, cooling, dehumidification, mixing, evaporative cooling, cooling towers
Combustion: fuels, stoichiometry, air-fuel ratio and products
Enthalpy of formation, adiabatic flame temperature and heating values
Exergy analysis of cycles and energy systems
